scope: Theorem 5.10 (Distributional Hessian comparison) of the manuscript “Gigli’s distributional curvature characterization of Alexandrov spaces” (preprints/Giglis-distributional-curvature-characterization-of-Alexandrov-spaces-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 356 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e104c43128bea292), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let n ≥ 2 be an integer, let κ ∈ R, and let (M, d, m), with m = Hn, be a full-support RCD((n − 1)κ, n) space satisfying (1.4) for every global X, Y ∈ TestV(M) and every nonnegative f ∈ Test(M). Fix Rκ > 0, with Rκ √ κ < π/2 if κ > 0. For every p ∈ M, put r = d(p, ·) and q = r2/2. Then for every compact test gradient Z, Hess q(Z, Z) on B(p, Rκ) is a signed Radon measure whose singular part with respect to m is nonpositive. It satisfies Hess q(Z, Z) ≤  |Z∥|2 + r s′ κ(r) sκ(r) |Z⊥|2  m. (5.14) Here |∇q| = r almost everywhere, and on {r > 0} Z∥ = ⟨Z, ∇q⟩ r2 ∇q, Z⊥ = Z − Z∥. At r = 0 the coefficient on the right-hand side of (5.14) is interpreted as |Z|2. The measure inequality holds, in particular, against every nonnegative compactly supported Lipschitz weight on the ball. The radius Rκ is independent of p.
